If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) over last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment swings sharply (alternating ±0.33) in last 3 days, apply a 0.5–1.0% upward adjustment to mid-horizon (8–15 days) forecast to smooth volatility.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is trending downward, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent premature correction.  
If sentiment is positive but forecast is below 68.00, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for mid-horizon (8–15 days) to align with bullish sentiment.
